title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28
source: akg d1000e>sony tc-110, tdk c-120sd cassettes, no nr

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording sounds crisp and full of ambience, but the missing second set limits the overall experience.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a mid‑'73 Dead show with surprising clarity for an audience source – the crowd noise and high end are vivid, though low/mid frequencies are a bit thin. Reviewers love the musical flow of the material that is present, but the recording stops after the first set, leaving the second set absent and disappointing some listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, well‑recorded first set earns high marks for sound quality, but the omission of the entire second set drags the overall rating down, resulting in a mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp overall with clear top end and strong crowd ambience; low/mid frequencies slightly under‑represented but still very listenable for an audience tape from 1973.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is praised for its energy and sound, but the recording ends abruptly—second set is missing entirely, which limits the concert's completeness.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar work described as crisp and enjoyable.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh mentioned in passing; no specific performance comments.
